actor.detail: Executed plan_002.md (architecture/002.md): rewrote append_history.py to folder form with lock + version guard + issues fallback, migrated history.json(16 events)->history/*.json and questions.md(Q1-Q10)->questions/*.md, created architecture/ and issues/ with root-level indexes/metas, updated SKILL.md/references/assets, validated via audit/show + end-to-end tests, then set implemented_version=2.

operation.change_summary: 执行 plan_002.md：迁移到文件夹形态（history/ questions/ issues/ architecture/ + plan 根索引与 meta）；脚本重写为 init/append/show/audit/rebuild-index/migrate/recover/set-implemented，append 采用互斥锁+索引版本守卫，异常走 issues/ 留档；修复 plan.md 硬编码快照（改指最新 architecture doc）；旧 history.json 与 questions.md 已删除。

comments: 执行过程中发现并修复两处实现缺陷：① audit 误把『目标版本已定义但未落地』当作数据不一致，改为 NOTE（进行中状态非 desync）；② raise_issue 在已持锁时无法再次获锁导致 issues_index 不更新，改为锁对持锁 PID 可重入。端到端验证：正常 append 成功；碰撞与锁超时均正确中止并完整留档 issues/{n}/（含 intended/existing/index_snapshot），排除故障后 append 恢复成功；rebuild-index 可修复滞后索引。migrate 为一次性容器变更，旧 event 内容原样保留（含旧 timestamp），符合只增不改。
